title: 28 Nov: US Compute Curbs Reach Southeast Asia
summary: Nvidia halts server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries as US cloud-access rules bite. Also: Trainium3's inference margin beats Nvidia's GB300, and 42 attorneys general fight the sale of Character.AI chats.

title: Fri 27 Nov: FCC clears SpaceX orbital data centres
summary: The FCC licensed SpaceX to put up to a million AI data-centre satellites in orbit. Also: the Nasdaq 100 fell into bear-market territory, and Amazon and Meta negotiate over the Muse shopping agent.

title: 26 Nov: AI Writes Landmark Math Proofs
summary: Anthropic and OpenAI post AI-written proofs of landmark complexity results. Also: the FCA says firms own their agents' risks, and Amazon reports agents exploiting a zero-day in eleven minutes.

title: Wed 25 Nov: Lab Insiders Say Models Too Risky
summary: Axios reports staff at Anthropic and OpenAI doubt their best unreleased models can be shipped safely. Also: Sierra raises $1.75B at a $30B valuation, and MiniMax admits its scanners opened customers' URLs.

title: 24 Nov: Washington helps Huang return to Nvidia
summary: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO with Washington's blessing. Also CrowdStrike's $43.9B deal for Zscaler and US banks fencing in their AI agents.

title: Mon 23 Nov: Claude-assisted Riemann proof machine-certified
summary: Lean and Mathlib certify the Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof. Also: three AI inference providers breached, and server makers repricing signed AI deals by up to forty-five percent.

title: Sun 22 Nov: Claude-assisted Riemann proof claimed
summary: A Claude-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis is claimed and under expert review. Also: Anthropic falls 11% on its second trading day, and Congress discloses 879,000 AI chip approvals for Chinese firms.

title: Sat 21 Nov: Anthropic's raise grows, then slides
summary: Anthropic's IPO grows to about ninety-three billion dollars before shares slide on day two. Also: OpenAI gates router access to its models, and Apple, Google and Replit push agents that run whole computers.

title: Fri 20 Nov: Anthropic trading and agent safeguards
summary: Anthropic closes its first trading day above the offering price, Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon, and new findings sharpen attention on agent safeguards and banking rules.

title: Thu 19 Nov: Anthropic IPO and bank agents
summary: Anthropic reportedly prices its IPO at $83; JPMorgan and Hyundai Card test agent-led FX; Meta faces questions about Muse and the ECB flags AI valuation risks.

title: Wed 18 Nov: New models, Nvidia earnings and agent controls
summary: OpenAI releases new models, Nvidia reports results, California sues OpenAI, and BNY tests agent-assisted Treasury trade negotiation with human approval.

title: Mon 16 Nov: Nvidia succession in focus
summary: A reported possible return for Jensen Huang puts Nvidia succession in focus. Vietnam’s bank AI rules take effect, and partners agree to protect AI supply chains.

title: Sun 15 Nov: Nvidia and AI funding
summary: Nvidia’s role in venture funding comes into focus after its leadership change. Onyx and Glean connect agent governance, while a closer look at an agent-detection test reveals important limits.

title: Sat 14 Nov: AI tops risk survey
summary: The Federal Reserve’s market contacts flag AI risks, OpenAI describes its card-backed wallet, and BCG benchmarks bank controls.
